test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To scratch one's head

options.text: To think hard in a puzzled way
To come up with an idea

solution:
The correct answer is: **To think hard in a puzzled way**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**to scratch one's head**" means **to think hard in a puzzled way**. (उलझन भरे तरीके से गहराई से सोचना)
 
• It is often used when someone is trying to solve a difficult problem or figure out a confusing situation.
 
• The phrase is derived from the physical act
